raw_html: [[Maiming]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Maiming]]:''' This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. Whenever you score a critical hit with this weapon it deals an amount of extra untyped damage depending on its critical multiplier: x2 - 1 to 6, x3 - 2 to 12, x4 - 3 to 18.
